title: Introducing the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter
summary: In this post, we introduce the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter, a fully managed service that enables AI agents to securely execute code in isolated sandbox environments. We discuss how the AgentCore Code Interpreter helps solve challenges around security, scalability, and infrastructure management when deploying AI agents that need computational capabilities.

title: Observing and evaluating AI agentic workflows with Strands Agents SDK and Arize AX
summary: In this post, we present how the Arize AX service can trace and evaluate AI agent tasks initiated through Strands Agents, helping validate the correctness and trustworthiness of agentic workflows.
